note: Facts for supply-chain stakeholders, as checked on 5 November 2026. `status` is what public records show, not a forecast: available means operating or produced; possible means announced, licensed or proven elsewhere; notfound means we found no record, which is not the same as none existing. Possibilities are questions to test, not recommendations.

available.text: 42.5 Mt mined in 2022-23, worth ₹16,994 crore and 16.5% of India's output.
Resources of 4,592 Mt of haematite and 106 Mt of magnetite, as of April 2020.
Steel is made here. The Indian Bureau of Mines lists Bhilai at 3.9 Mt of crude steel. NMDC's 3 Mt Nagarnar plant sits about 100 km from the Bailadila mines.

possible.text: Electrical steel. India made about 50,000 t against demand of about 400,000 t in FY2024. The Indian Bureau of Mines lists no plant in the state.
Battery cathodes. LFP uses iron and made up over 55% of EV batteries deployed worldwide in 2025. Production of LFP cathodes is still almost entirely in China. We found no cathode plant in the state.

risky.text: One mineral carries the state: iron ore is 87% of non-fuel mineral value in 2022-23.
Steel entering the EU has faced its carbon charge (CBAM) since January 2026. In 2022, 27% of India's iron, steel and aluminium product exports went to the EU.

Protests over Deposit 13 closed five existing Bailadila mines for six days in June 2019, and the state stopped pre-mining work on the deposit itself. 29 residents told the enquiry their thumb impressions on a Gram Sabha consent were forged.

possible.small: India makes only 1/8 of what it needs

ground.small: Iron ore is 87% of non-fuel mineral value

made.small: Applies to steel imports since January 2026

available.text: 185 Mt mined in 2022-23. The Indian Bureau of Mines publishes no value for fuel minerals.
85,263 Mt of resources as of April 2025.
NTPC's coal plant at Korba has 2,600 MW installed.

possible.text: Data-centre demand nearby. RackBank's AI park at Nava Raipur was announced with 80 MW in its first phase, and the operator now talks of 500 MW by 2027. A tracker has listed it as under construction since May 2025, with 160 MW at full build-out.
Battery anodes from coal tar. Tata Steel reports a pilot of 1 t a year, outside this state. Most needle coke has come from petroleum.

risky.text: Almost none of it is steelmaking coal: about 0.5% of resources are coking grades.
Hasdeo Arand is contested. Villagers were reported protesting in January 2026, and campaigners criticised a state forest department decision on 1,740 ha for Kente Extension in August 2025.

possible.small: Tata Steel has piloted them from coal tar, elsewhere

ground.small: Protests at Hasdeo Arand, reported in 2026

made.small: About 0.5% of resources are coking grades

available.text: India's sole producer of tin concentrates: 45 t in 2022-23, up from 26 t.
36% of India's tin ore resources. The state's geology directorate puts recoverable cassiterite at 19,545 t.
One smelter: Precious Minerals and Smelting at Jagdalpur made 17 t of metal in 2022-23, up from 4.9 t.

possible.text: Replacing imports. India imported 13,507 t of tin and alloys in 2022-23, against that 17 t.

New deposits. In April 2025 the state gave the Centre reports on three tin deposits for e-auction, in Dantewada, Sukma and Bastar districts. A tin ore block in Sukma and Bastar, Chittalnar-Kumakoleng, was auctioned in January 2026, with Harban Singh & Sons Enterprises named preferred bidder.
Strategic pull. Tin is on India's critical list, and the most advanced chip machines make their light from tin droplets.

risky.text: Scale. 45 t of concentrates against about 290,000 t of world mine output. The two are not measured identically, but the gap is not close.
Traceability. The state's mineral corporation buys concentrates from tribal collectors in its lease area. A Tin portal launched in August 2026 aims at fairer prices.
Due diligence. EU conflict minerals rules cover tin from conflict-affected and high-risk areas. Buyers should ask how Bastar is classed. We do not classify it.

possible.small: India imported 13,507 t of tin and alloys in 2022-23

ground.small: 45 t a year, against 290,000 t worldwide

made.small: Concentrates are bought from tribal collectors

available.text: 1.06 Mt from 13 mines in 2022-23, worth ₹125 crore, from 993 Mt of resources.
BALCO's Korba smelter made first metal from a new 525 kA line in October 2025, in an expansion to 1 Mt a year.

possible.text: Gallium nitride chips. Polymatech laid the foundation for a ₹1,143 crore plant at Nava Raipur in April 2025 and targeted production by mid-2026. We found no confirmation it has started.

Gallium recovery. Gallium comes from alumina refining. The IEA estimates data centres could need over 10% of today's gallium supply in 2030. NALCO plans India's first recovery, 10 t a year, in Odisha. The Indian Bureau of Mines listed Korba's alumina plant as non-operational.

The state names Balrampur for gallium, graphite and vanadium potential. That is a government statement, not a resource estimate. A block listing gallium with bauxite, Sabag (North), is in the latest national auction round.

risky.text: Concentration. China makes 99% of primary gallium, 62% of alumina and 61% of aluminium.
Local ore cannot feed the local smelter. 1 Mt of aluminium needs 4 to 6 Mt of bauxite, and the state mined 1.06 Mt. This is our arithmetic.
Aluminium entering the EU has faced its carbon charge (CBAM) since January 2026.

possible.small: ₹1,143 crore plant announced, start not confirmed

ground.small: 1.06 Mt mined; a 1 Mt smelter needs 4 to 6 Mt

made.small: Applies to aluminium imports since January 2026

available.text: 44.7 Mt from 75 mines in 2022-23, worth ₹1,275 crore, from 13,211 Mt of resources.
The Indian Bureau of Mines lists more than a dozen cement units in the state.

possible.text: Solar glass. Solar cover glass is low in iron, and ordinary limestone can carry too much. One patent avoids it for a purer calcium source. We found no iron data for the state's deposits, so this needs testing first.
New leases. Laladhurwa-Jognipali and Sandi were auctioned as limestone mining leases in 2022-23.

risky.text: On neither the EU's nor India's critical list.
Cement entering the EU has faced its carbon charge (CBAM) since January 2026.

possible.small: Purity matters. We found no iron data for local limestone

ground.small: On neither the EU's nor India's list

made.small: Applies to cement imports since January 2026

available.text: 11% of India's dolomite resources, and the Indian Bureau of Mines counts the state among the leading producers.
The Indian Bureau of Mines' production table has no dolomite row, so we show no output figure.

possible.text: Magnesium metal. The Pidgeon process makes it from calcined dolomite. USGS names no Indian producer, and we found no plant in the state.
Flat glass. Dolomite is a standard ingredient. We found no grade data for the state's deposits.

risky.text: Concentration. China makes 86% of the world's magnesium metal.
Thin data. We found no published output, grade or buyer for the state's dolomite.

possible.small: US Geological Survey lists no Indian magnesium producer

ground.small: None published that we could find

acrossAll.title: EU carbon charge
acrossAll.text: The EU's charge on imports (CBAM) has applied in full since 1 January 2026. It covers iron and steel, aluminium, cement, fertilisers, electricity and hydrogen.

acrossAll.title: Land and consent
acrossAll.text: Protests closed five Bailadila mines for six days in 2019, and land disputes continue at Hasdeo Arand. India's first lithium block is a third forest: 85 of 256 ha.

acrossAll.title: Security
acrossAll.text: India's Home Minister declared Bastar Naxal-free in May 2026. Police name de-mining and development as the remaining work. These are official statements.

acrossAll.title: Data age
acrossAll.text: The best state-level production figures are from 2022-23. No public source traces ore from mine to plant to buyer.

watchlist.intro: Beyond the six. The state says 65 mineral blocks have been auctioned. In July 2026 the Centre cancelled nine critical-mineral auctions from the previous round, citing poor investor response and a lack of qualified bidders.

items.name: Lithium
items.text: India's first lithium-bearing block to be auctioned. Reported grades are modest.

items.name: Rare earths
items.text: Reconnaissance by the Geological Survey of India in 2021-22.

items.name: Fluorite
items.text: 545,455 t of resources. Fluorspar is on the EU's critical list.

auction.title: Five Chhattisgarh blocks in the latest national auction round
auction.intro: Tranche VIII was notified on 15 July 2026, and auctions began on 15 October. On 5 November 2026 the results page listed 8 of the round's 20 blocks, one of them here. It does not say why the others are missing. Being named preferred bidder is not the same as being granted the licence.
